description: We are passionate students from Uzbekistan with strong backgrounds in competitive programming, algorithms, and problem-solving. We’re interested in AI, software development, space exploration, and educational technology. Our goal is to build an engaging game that simulates managing a lunar or Martian outpost. We’re looking for creative teammates skilled in game development, UI/UX design, 3D modeling, space science, or frontend development. Let’s build something impactful together!
